citation: Garces et al. 2020. Serum angiopoietin-like 3 levels are elevated in obese non diabetic men but are unaffected during an oral glucose tolerance test. Scientific Reports 10:21118.
protocol: 75 g anhydrous glucose in 200 mL water; blood at 0, 30, 60, 120 min
population: 28 healthy lean men (age 24.6 +/- 3.5, BMI 22.1) and 30 obese non-diabetic men (age 23.9, BMI 37.9), Spain
note: Lean healthy group printed separately with full 4-point glucose and insulin means. Insulin 30-min SD in the table looks implausibly small for the lean group (4.58 around 81.5); a reader should check. Units mg/dL and uIU/mL.
